assessment_date.description: The date the form itself carries, distinct from submission time.

asset.description: The plant item the assessment is about, where the title's suffix resolves to exactly one registered asset.

attributes.description: Every remaining form answer, keyed by the tenant's own question text, plus `_raw_metadata` at rest. This is where the **270 person-name-like slugs** (814 fact-field occurrences) and the **24 excluded tenant-authored keys** (881 occurrences, longest 115 characters) live; both are counted, not named (SC002).

controls_implemented.description: Controls in place at the time of the assessment.

controls_recommended.description: Controls or actions recommended by the assessment.

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source record (Assignar form-result id, cast to text).

financial_period.description: The accounting period the record falls in, derived from `occurred_at`.

form_id.description: The Assignar form-template id, the stable twin of `form_title`.

form_title.description: The matched Assignar form's title — which instrument this fact is.

hazard_description.description: The hazard identified, and its details.

occurred_at.description: When the assessment or hazard report was submitted; the event time and the retention clock start.

occurred_on.description: The date the hazard or occurrence happened, where the form states one.

project.description: The project the assessment was recorded against, where the source gives one.

reported_by.description: The person who reported the hazard.

reported_on.description: The date the hazard was reported, where the form states one.

reported_to.description: The person the hazard was reported to.

risk_rating.description: The risk-matrix selection the form records.

source_system.description: Originating system; `ASSIGNAR` today and the only system the frozen universe names.

worker.description: The worker who submitted or signed the record; the required subject anchor.
